scenarios.label: Standing, shakers on
scenarios.note: The person stands still 1.64 m from the wall on the floor's beam line; three shakers drive the structure with the same forces on every planet.

scenarios.label: Walking 1.0 m/s, shakers on
scenarios.note: Gait re-tuned on each planet to published reduced-gravity gait data; same shaker forces everywhere.

scenarios.label: Earth gait slowed down, shakers on
scenarios.note: What-if case: the Earth gait replayed in slow motion (equal Froude number).

scenarios.label: Walking 1.0 m/s, footsteps only
scenarios.note: Nothing but the walker's own footsteps moves the structure.

scenarios.label: Earth gait slowed down, footsteps only
3-D walker 1.0 m/s, shakers on
scenarios.note: Phase G: the 3-D walker with sideways balance, 1.0 m/s, tuned on each planet (Stage 1 Earth, Stage 2 Mars and Moon); compare with the side-view walker.

recovery_rule.chosen_on: S1's frozen rule, not re-tuned (declared, Phase K)
recovery_rule.stride_frequency: each device's own gait clock (Phase J): pooled over the records and twins of a case per side, mean of the sides; per crossing for the per-crossing scores

before_phase_J.stride_frequency: harmonic sum over the device spectrum
